# Vision Flow Group — Sovereign AI Engineering, Offensive Security, Commercial VFX & Research Ecosystem

> Canonical Motherbrand: https://visionflowgroup.com/ | Wikidata: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q141910527 | Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh (Serving 15+ Countries)

Vision Flow Group is a Bangladeshi artificial intelligence research, RLHF/S2S evaluation, offensive AI cybersecurity, full-stack software/SaaS, commercial video/VFX post-production, and practical technical education ecosystem founded in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

## Canonical Divisions & Products

- [Vision Flow Group (Motherbrand Hub)](https://visionflowgroup.com/): Corporate registry, R&D sandbox, executive principals, and cross-division index.
- [Vision Flow Agency](https://agency.visionflowgroup.com/): Autonomous AI agents, full-stack Next.js/Cloudflare/Flutter SaaS, offensive AI red teaming, broadcast video editing & VFX, and technical SEO/GEO/LEO.
- [Vision Flow Academy](https://academy.visionflowgroup.com/): Practical live-project engineering & creative residency in Bangladesh (Applied AI, Red Teaming, Web/SaaS, Commercial Video & VFX, Growth SEO).
- [Vision Flow AI Studio](https://studio.visionflowgroup.com/): Commercial AI storyboard director, Whisper word-boundary alignment, native CapCut PC `.json` / Premiere XML / DaVinci EDL timeline exporter, and encrypted Cloud 2FA Vault.
- [VisionFlow Free Tools](https://go.visionflowgroup.com/): 9 zero-ad, privacy-first browser utilities (HD social video saver, 9-Tag AI prompt enhancer, Bangla/BDT invoice maker, local WebAssembly background remover, PDF/image converter, QR & TOTP).
- [Vision Flow Client Portal](https://portal.visionflowgroup.com/): Authenticated milestone delivery, review, and billing workspace.
